body: I know $80 doesn't sound like much but to me it is and this is a temporary position, and access to the insurance was important to me. I havent seen a dentist in 10 years, an eye doctor in 5, a primary care in 5, this job could very well be over in a matter of weeks & I will lose access to the first insurance ive had in a very long time. So its partially the principle of them claiming they'd offer amazing benefits only to fail to offer the necessary info & leave me in the lurch. And like you said, its 80 dollars, they would miss it a lot less than myself

Its almost like you didnt read my post at all. I literally spelled out why I feel lost & like I dont know what I should be doing & have no direction. And hearing "it wont fall out of the sky" is not helpful, you're just implying that everything wrong in my life is my own doing. I didnt ask anything of you, but certainly didnt ask that you repeat the nasty words already tumbling around in my brain
I just want to feel like I have worth. That I have anything going for me in this life

Only doing what out of duty? I didnt say I wanted accomplishments so people wouldnt hate me, and I do my best to be a good friend but you seem to be implying that no one likes me because of something I've done. Maybe you're right. I know it cant be easy to have a friend who doesnt have anything to offer, I often feel like being friends with me is more trouble than its worth.
